title: IABRW Appendix 11 — International Pre-race Data in Support of Race Cards
covers: Sand; Synthetic surface; All-weather; Draw; Local time; Time zone; Stakes race
note: IFHA data standard distinguishes Dirt/Sand as a natural non-turf surface, requires All-Weather to be synthetic, uses Post position/Draw/Barrier Position, identifies race Post time as local time, and carries stake-race indicators. Treat as international data semantics, not proof that every jurisdiction uses identical labels.

title: Program Help — Race Types
note: Equibase defines STK/Stakes as a North American race type and gives specific nomination/entry/starter-fee criteria; use for North American scope rather than a universal stakes definition.

title: Live Racing Search Results
covers: Local time; Time zone; Stakes race
note: Current Equibase meeting table exposes 1st Post Local, Time Zone and Stakes Race(s) as separate racing data fields.

title: Barrier Draw Independent Audit
note: Racing Australia describes the Barrier Draw software as assigning barrier numbers to horses and documents random-draw integrity controls.

title: What is Pool Betting?
note: Official Tote guide describes Tote betting as pooled wagering rather than bookmaker fixed odds; Tote remains an operator/system-sensitive term.

title: Glossary — Starting Price / SP
note: The Jockey Club defines Starting Price as the final odds prevailing when the race starts and identifies SP as its abbreviation; supports one Concept plus an abbreviation label, not two Concepts.
